replies.author: LeCobalt
replies.body:
Is it just me or are all map releases the same?

They all have:
  • Meaningless void.
  • Some form of "protection" (cobwebs, water, sugarcane, soul-sand).
  • Some custom shape on top of the void.
  • The repeating pattern on the walls of these custom shapes.
  • SLABS because that's the only decoration block that is mandatory everywhere.
  • Hard to get ores.

If someone actually placed around 5 hours on coding on java, he/she could make a custom avicus map generator that transformed a .png picture into the generic map we all know.

I know these maps are fun to play on and that they're the generic style-map for DTMs, but still, it's ok to have 2 maps like these, maybe even 3, but not having the entire DTM servers on maps like these.

replies.body:
I believe that if you played the map as well, you'd feel the same way. Instead of looking at it from a creator's perspective, think of what the players would want. Creativity just makes it better. If its playable, people will like it. The most aggravating thing about this server is the fact that people can't stand constructive criticism. All they want to hear is "that's a very nice map sweetie (:" and "I worship you because you put quartz in the map oh my god!!!!!!!!!!! <3333". Don't make a map if you can't stand constructive criticism. Use it to your advantage to make a better map, proving people that you can actually make good maps.


On another note, I agree that most Avicus maps look the same. There's no exact variety, and every map has the same setup. If you're looking for change then expand your knowledge. Stop complaining when people give you bad reviews on your maps.

Moral of the story: don't cry when you receive criticism, use it to improve, on this dumb legos game and in real life.  It is crucial to growing up.
